1.title: Drape tie around your collar
1.say: Lay the blue striped tie around your open collar with the pattern facing out. Hang the wide blue pointed end much longer on your right. Hang the skinny blue pointed end short on your left.
placements: wide blue pointed striped end → hanging down the shirt front on the right side of the collar opening with the pattern facing out and the tip pointing down and much longer than the other side, held in the right hand (in the video: right side of the white shirt front)

skinny blue pointed striped end → hanging down the shirt front on the left side of the collar opening with the pattern facing out and the tip pointing down and short, held in the left hand (in the video: left side of the white shirt front)
watch_for: if both ends hang the same length the knot will end too short, the wide end must start much longer than the skinny end
if the shiny patterned side faces in toward the shirt the tie will look inside out, flip it so the stripes show on the outside
1.check_yourself: It should look like the blue tie lying around the white collar with both ends hanging down the shirt front and the wide end much longer.

2.title: Cross wide end over skinny end
2.say: Bring the wide blue striped end on your right across over the skinny blue end. Hold the crossing down in the middle of your chest.
placements: wide blue pointed striped end → laid over the top of the skinny blue end in the middle of the shirt chest just below the collar to make an X shape with the wide side on top (in the video: center of the white shirt front just below the collar, wide from the right over skinny from the left)
watch_for: if the skinny end lies on top of the wide end the knot will not form, lay the wide end over the top instead
if the cross sits far down the shirt the knot will sit low, keep the cross just below the collar
2.check_yourself: It should look like the two blue ends crossing in the middle of the shirt to make an X below the collar.

3.title: Bring wide end up through neck
3.say: Bring the wide blue striped end behind and up through the neck opening. Pull it straight up toward your chin to snug the cross.
placements: wide blue pointed striped end → passed behind the crossing and up through the opening around the neck between the collar and the crossing with the tip pointing up toward the chin, pulled to snug the cross (in the video: up through the middle of the white collar opening with the crossing cinched below the collar)
watch_for: if the wide end goes over the front instead of behind the cross will fall apart, pass it behind then up through the neck opening
if the wide end hangs down after this move you did not pull it up, the tip should point up toward the chin
3.check_yourself: It should look like the wide blue end pointing up through the neck opening with the crossing pulled snug below the collar.

4.title: Wrap wide end across front
4.say: Bring the wide blue striped end across the front from your right to your left. Lay it flat to make a straight band over the middle.
placements: wide blue pointed striped end → wrapped sideways across the front of the knot from the right side of the chest to the left side lying flat as a straight horizontal band over the middle with the tip sticking out to the side (in the video: horizontal blue band across the center of the knot with the tip out to the left side of the frame)
watch_for: if the wrap twists like a rope the front will look lumpy, keep the cloth flat as a straight band
if you wrap toward the wrong side the next tuck will be hard, wrap from your right to your left
4.check_yourself: It should look like a flat horizontal blue band wrapped across the center with the wide end sticking out to the side.

5.title: Tuck wide end down through wrap
5.say: Lift the wide blue striped end up through the neck opening from below. Tuck the tip down through the straight band in front. Pull it all the way down toward your belly.
placements: wide blue pointed striped end → lifted up through the neck opening from below then tucked tip down through the straight horizontal band in front ending hanging down the center over the skinny end (in the video: centered over the white shirt front hanging straight down through the front wrap)
watch_for: if you tuck through the neck opening instead of the front band the end will hang loose, tuck only through the straight band in front
if the wide end ends off to the side the knot will be crooked, it should hang down the center over the skinny end
5.check_yourself: It should look like the wide blue end hanging down through the front wrap centered over the skinny end.

6.title: Slide knot up to collar
6.say: Pull the wide blue striped end down while holding the skinny blue end. Slide the knot up to sit centered under the collar.
placements: blue striped knot → slid up with both hands to sit centered in the V of the collar opening snug against the top button (in the video: neat triangular blue knot centered under the white collar)
wide blue pointed striped end → pulled straight down the center of the shirt front over the skinny end to tighten (in the video: hanging straight down the middle of the white shirt)
watch_for: if the knot sits off to one side the tie looks crooked, slide it until it is centered under the collar
if the knot stays loose and flat the wrap will show gaps, pull the wide end down while holding the skinny end to snug it
6.check_yourself: It should look like a neat triangular blue knot sitting centered under the collar with the wide end hanging straight down the shirt.
